limits: A prediction for wild-type SpCas9 only.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: One predicted activity per protospacer. The score belongs to the guide table, whose reading is on crispr_design_guides.
bio.jane/contract.question: What indel frequency does DeepSpCas9 predict for each 30-nt context?

description: Score CRISPR guides with DeepSpCas9 (Kim et al. 2019, Sci Adv 5:eaax9249): a predicted INDEL FREQUENCY IN PERCENT for wild-type SpCas9.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

contexts.description: the 30-nt contexts to score, exactly as DeepSpCas9 takes them: 4 nt upstream, the 20-nt spacer, the 3-nt PAM and 3 nt downstream. Anything that is not 30 nt of unambiguous A/C/G/T scores null, with the reason beside it, rather than being trimmed or padded.

name: crispr_score_deepspcas9

best.description: the highest-scoring context, or empty when none could be scored

indelPercents.description: just the numbers, same order — null-preserving, so it lines up with the input

scored.description: how many of the inputs DeepSpCas9 is defined on — the accounting, not an assumption

scores.description: every context with its predicted indel percentage, IN THE ORDER GIVEN — null where the model is not defined, with the reason beside it
